First tap on a floating phrase comes within 60 seconds of load (4 intro cards are short, then the moving cards invite a tap)
At least one tap changes nothing on screen, from chasing a drifting card or tapping Show turn marks
Player sees the fresh-not-cliche penalty line at least once because Smash cliche is the loudest red button
Player answers the notice question correctly; card 2 says it splits the poem in two and the bold red ya box makes it stick

predictions.claim: Player rates I knew what to do next at 4 or 5; the status line names the three moves but the menus overlap the stream
A cold phone player is done inside 4 minutes; with no end state in Spring they stop when the lines feel full or stuck

notes: State 0: the Japanese is gorgeous but I do not know what ya is until I tap Next; the dark Next button wins over the pale Skip link, and 1 of 4 tells me it is short, so I read on.

State 3 to 4: I tapped the paper boat, the Catch line / Smash cliche / Let it go buttons popped up right on top of the other cards, and when I went for the carp card my thumb hit Smash cliche instead; the water clouded and I did not know why I was punished.
State 8: the frog tongue snapping the cliche is the best moment in the game; I get it instantly and want to find another one to smash.
States 16, 24, 32: I tapped Show turn marks and the button went black but the only change was a small red 切 tile over a card; I would not notice it and would tap it again thinking it did nothing.

halts.check: Action menu overlays neighboring stream phrases, so a tap aimed at another phrase lands on Smash cliche and costs clear water
halts.evidence: Step 4 tapped 'the carp flips' label while the paper-boat menu was open; result state 4 reads 'a child's paper boat is fresh, not a cliché... the water clouds' and Clear water drops 3 to 2; screenshot 03 shows Smash cliche at y~240 covering the carp card

halts.check: Show turn marks produces no text change and only a small visual mark, reading as a dead control to a first player
